note: Benchmark results rendered into docs/reference/sota-models.mdx under ## Benchmarks. Numbers come from the two in-repo benchmark harnesses: benchmarks/roadmapbench (RoadmapBench, real audited smithers result) and benchmarks/site (benchmarks.smithers.sh, sourced from benchmarks/results.json). A row's `models` are exact SOTA-registry ids; generate-sota.ts drops any row whose model is deprecated or absent from the registry, so older-model rows (e.g. Claude Opus 4.6, GPT-5.2) never render. Reference baselines with no specific registry model use `label` instead. Edit this file, then run `pnpm sota:gen`.

benchmarks.name: RoadmapBench
benchmarks.headline: Long-horizon, multi-target version upgrades: start from a repo pinned to an old release and implement every independent feature a real upstream bump introduced (median oracle change ~3,700 LOC across ~51 files; median 5 scored targets). The best single agent on the official leaderboard resolves under 40% of tasks.

rows.note: every grader fair-validated (oracle=1.0, no-op<1.0); every run audited untainted. Not a full-115 claim.

benchmarks.name: SWE-Bench Pro
benchmarks.headline: 731 multi-file tasks across 11 professional repos (Go/Python/JS/TS) graded by hidden tests in canonical per-instance Docker. Moonshot reports Kimi K2.6 tying GPT-5.5 here at roughly 80% lower cost.
